spoken_text: Sam, quick nightly read on the ads. Spend is back under the cap — about ninety-nine percent of the weekly budget, so no runaway. The Samples ads are efficient, but Contract Manufacturing is still running an expensive click because Smart Bidding is guessing without any real lead signal to learn from. We got no attributable leads again today, which is the same root problem: Google is optimizing blind. My recommendation is to switch Contract Manufacturing back to manual bidding so we control cost until we wire up conversion tracking. That one needs your yes.
